Usage: headroom accounts add <email> [flags]

Seed the dir for a new subscription.

Seeds the dir for a new subscription: ~/.claude-accounts/<email> (or ~/.codex-accounts/
<email> under --vendor codex), its session store linked to the machine-global one so every
account sees every session. --share-config links a whitelist of the primary's config —
settings, skills, commands — into it; --share-config=<dir> links every entry of that dir.
A login, its history and its session registry are never linked, whatever the source holds.
For Claude Code, the primary's settings.json is linked even without the flag: every account
prunes the one session store by its own settings, so an account with settings of its own can
delete every other account's history.

Then log in once: for Claude Code, headroom launch --account <email> and /login in the
session; for Codex, headroom launch --vendor codex --account <email> -- login.

Arguments:
  <email>                The new subscription's email: the account's dir name, and the login it must
                         hold.

Flags:
      --share-config     Link the primary's config into the new dir; --share-config=<dir> links
                         every entry of <dir> instead.

Inherited flags:
      --vendor=VENDOR    The vendor whose accounts these are: the board shows only its; add and
                         remove act on it, Claude Code when absent (one of: claude, codex).
  -h, --help             Show context-sensitive help.
      --version          Print the build this binary is — its commit and the commit's time — and
                         exit.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments, nothing was run; for check, an assertion it could not test (INCONCLUSIVE)
  3    headless place refused: every account it could take is near a limit or excluded; login start,
       finish or cancel refused, nothing spent or sent: the document's reason says why
